title: Apollo Lunar Module
verification: The user-supplied GLB and the separately retrieved NASA download are byte-for-byte identical.
fidelity: NASA labels this a generic Apollo Lunar Module. Its page does not certify every detail as Apollo 11 LM-5 Eagle. It is a simplified visualisation, not an engineering model.
materials: Original GLB contains 12 materials and embedded image textures. Runtime viewing mode increases gold/amber, silver and dark material contrast and uses environment lighting. Original model colors are available through a control. These adjustments are illustrative display choices, not exact historical surface-color measurements.
